"""Authored divided-road U-turn requests for the frozen C82860 cell.

The two requests share a road and controller path shape. Their crossing x
coordinate is the only deliberate comparison difference. Public authority is
an original source question and is never inferred from this road geometry.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


ASSIGNMENT = "training__C82860__NRS-484B-227-1__motor_vehicle_driver"
ROAD_IDS = (828601, 828602)
CAMERAS = (
    ("overview", 1920, 1080),
    ("approach", 1280, 720),
    ("reference_corner", 1280, 720),
    ("driver_reference", 1280, 720),
)


def road_xml():
    root = ET.Element("OpenDRIVE")
    ET.SubElement(root, "header", revMajor="1", revMinor="4",
                  name="C82860-divided-median", version="1", north="20",
                  south="-20", east="70", west="-70", vendor="worker-authored")
    for road_id, name, x, y, heading in (
        (ROAD_IDS[0], "eastbound_right_hand_roadway", -70, -5, 0),
        (ROAD_IDS[1], "westbound_right_hand_roadway", 70, 5, math.pi),
    ):
        road = ET.SubElement(root, "road", id=str(road_id), name=name,
                             length="140", junction="-1")
        ET.SubElement(road, "link")
        view = ET.SubElement(road, "planView")
        ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(view, "geometry", s="0", x=str(x),
                                    y=str(y), hdg=str(heading), length="140"), "line")
        profile = ET.SubElement(road, "elevationProfile")
        ET.SubElement(profile, "elevation", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
        lanes = ET.SubElement(road, "lanes")
        ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneOffset", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
        section = ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
        ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section, "center"), "lane", id="0",
                      type="none", level="false")
        lane = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section, "right"), "lane", id="-1",
                             type="driving", level="false")
        ET.SubElement(lane, "width", sOffset="0", a="3.5", b="0", c="0", d="0")
        objects = ET.SubElement(road, "objects")
        if road_id == ROAD_IDS[0]:
            for index, start in enumerate((-20, 3), 1):
                ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id=str(index),
                              name=f"median_dividing_section_{index}",
                              type="barrier", s=str(start + 70), t="5",
                              zOffset="0", hdg="0", pitch="0", roll="0",
                              length="17", width="4", height="0.25")
        ET.SubElement(road, "signals")
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")


def request(crossing):
    if crossing not in ("authorized_opening", "barrier_crossing"):
        raise ValueError("unknown exact crossing request")
    x = 0 if crossing == "authorized_opening" else 10
    return {
        "format": "worker-authored-divided-uturn-request",
        "assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT,
        "case_id": ASSIGNMENT + "__" + crossing,
        "cell_id": "C82860", "actor": "motor_vehicle_driver",
        "layout": "divided_road", "maneuver": "u_turn",
        "source_map": road_xml(),
        "road_ids": list(ROAD_IDS),
        "ego_blueprint": "vehicle.tesla.model3",
        "start_xyz_m": [-25, -6.75, 1.5],
        "route_waypoints_xy_m": [[-25, -6.75], [x - 5, -6.75], [x, -6.75],
                                  [x, 0], [x, 6.75], [x - 5, 6.75]],
        "requested_crossing_x_m": x,
        "median_bounds_m": [-20, -2, 20, 2],
        "opening_bounds_m": [-3, -2, 3, 2],
        "barrier_bounds_m": [[-20, -2, -3, 2], [3, -2, 20, 2]],
        "public_authority_establishment": "pending_original_source",
        "physical_realization": "unverified",
        "rate_hz": 20, "duration_s": 30, "frames": 600,
        "cameras": [{"name": n, "width": w, "height": h} for n, w, h in CAMERAS],
        "legal_verdict": None,
    }


def check(first, second):
    expected = ("authorized_opening", "barrier_crossing")
    for case, item in zip(expected, (first, second)):
        if item != request(case):
            raise ValueError("exact U-turn request differs: " + case)
        root = ET.fromstring(item["source_map"])
        roads = root.findall("road")
        if [int(road.attrib["id"]) for road in roads] != list(ROAD_IDS):
            raise ValueError("both opposing Native roadways required")
        names = [obj.attrib["name"] for obj in root.findall(".//object")]
        if names != ["median_dividing_section_1", "median_dividing_section_2"]:
            raise ValueError("physical median sections and opening required")
    if first["requested_crossing_x_m"] == second["requested_crossing_x_m"]:
        raise ValueError("comparison crossing location not varied")
    return {"passed": True, "physical_native_verified": False,
            "authority_verified": False, "cases": [x["case_id"] for x in (first, second)]}


def write(directory):
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cases = [request("authorized_opening"), request("barrier_crossing")]
    check(*cases)
    for item in cases:
        suffix = item["case_id"].split("__")[-1]
        (directory / (suffix + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(item, indent=2) + "\n")
    return cases


if __name__ == "__main__":
    write(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "requests")

"""Capture an authored C82860 divided-road U-turn with original Native joins."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from road_request import CAMERAS, ROAD_IDS, request as exact_request

FRAMES = 600
CAMERA_POSES = {
    'overview': ((0, -19, 25), (0, -52, 90), False),
    'approach': ((1.2, 0, 2.0), (0, -8, 0), True),
    'reference_corner': ((9, -14, 11), (0, -22, 90), False),
    'driver_reference': ((1, 14, 11), (0, -22, -90), False),
}


def check():
    root = Path.cwd()
    config = json.loads((root/'config.json').read_text())
    request = json.loads((root/'request.json').read_text())
    if request != exact_request(request["case_id"].split("__")[-1]):
        raise ValueError("Exact U-turn construction request differs")
    if config['selected_case_id'] != config['case_id'] or config['case_id'] != request['case_id']:
        raise ValueError('Exact U-turn case identity differs')
    if (config['rate_hz'], config['duration_s'], config['frames']) != (20, 30, FRAMES):
        raise ValueError('Capture duration differs')
    if hashlib.sha256((root/'request.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() != config['request_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('U-turn request hash differs')
    if (root/'road.xodr').read_text() != request['source_map']:
        raise ValueError('Authored road differs')
    return {'passed': True, 'case_id': config['case_id'], 'frames': FRAMES,
            'physical_native_verified': False, 'authority_verified': False}


def ego_row(actor):
    pose = actor.get_transform()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    body = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(pose)
    bottom = sorted(body, key=lambda vertex: vertex.z)[:4]
    bottom.sort(key=lambda vertex: math.atan2(vertex.y-pose.location.y,
                                              vertex.x-pose.location.x))
    return {'actor_id': actor.id, 'blueprint_id': actor.type_id,
            'center_xyz_m': [pose.location.x, pose.location.y, pose.location.z],
            'yaw_deg': pose.rotation.yaw,
            'body_xy_m': [[vertex.x, vertex.y] for vertex in bottom],
            'body_xyz_m': [[vertex.x, vertex.y, vertex.z] for vertex in body],
            'speed_mps': math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2),
            'velocity_xyz_mps': [velocity.x, velocity.y, velocity.z]}


def control_to_target(actor, target):
    pose = actor.get_transform()
    dx, dy = target[0]-pose.location.x, target[1]-pose.location.y
    distance = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    bearing = math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx))
    error = ((bearing-pose.rotation.yaw+180) % 360)-180
    steer = max(-.65, min(.65, error/55))
    return distance, steer


def execute(output, host, port):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore
    check()
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if output != Path.cwd().resolve():
        raise ValueError('Capture requires the fresh materialized exact bundle')
    if any((output/name).exists() for name in ('native-uturn.jsonl', 'video_frames.jsonl', 'capture-seal.json')):
        raise ValueError('Original acquisition already exists')
    request = json.loads((output/'request.json').read_text())
    config = json.loads((output/'config.json').read_text())
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(180)
    old_world = client.get_world()
    saved = snapshot(client)
    if old_world.get_settings().synchronous_mode or any(
            actor.type_id.startswith(('vehicle.', 'walker.', 'sensor.', 'controller.'))
            for actor in old_world.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError('Exclusive idle Native world required')
    owned = []
    encoders = {}
    cameras = {}
    capture = None
    changed = False
    restoration = None
    try:
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world((output/'road.xodr').read_text(),
            carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(vertex_distance=.25,
                max_road_length=50, wall_height=0, additional_width=0,
                smooth_junctions=False, enable_mesh_visibility=True,
                enable_pedestrian_navigation=False))
        changed = True
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        settings.substepping = True
        settings.max_substep_delta_time = .01
        settings.max_substeps = 10
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        world.set_weather(carla.WeatherParameters.ClearNoon)
        map_source = world.get_map().to_opendrive()
        roadways = []
        for road_id in ROAD_IDS:
            waypoint = world.get_map().get_waypoint_xodr(road_id, -1, 65)
            if waypoint is None or waypoint.lane_type != carla.LaneType.Driving:
                raise RuntimeError('Native divided roadway missing: '+str(road_id))
            roadways.append({'road_id': road_id, 'lane_id': -1,
                             'heading_deg': waypoint.transform.rotation.yaw,
                             'center_y_m': waypoint.transform.location.y,
                             'lane_width_m': waypoint.lane_width})
        if abs(((roadways[0]['heading_deg']-roadways[1]['heading_deg']+180) % 360)-180) < 150:
            raise RuntimeError('Native roadways are not opposing directions')
        objects = [dict(item.attrib) for item in ET.fromstring(map_source).findall('.//object')
                   if item.get('name', '').startswith('median_dividing_section_')]
        if len(objects) != 2:
            raise RuntimeError('Native median objects not retained')
        blueprints = world.get_blueprint_library()
        blueprint = blueprints.find(request['ego_blueprint'])
        blueprint.set_attribute('role_name', 'c82860_uturn_subject')
        start = request['start_xyz_m']
        ego = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, carla.Transform(
            carla.Location(x=start[0], y=start[1], z=config['spawn_z_m']),
            carla.Rotation(yaw=0)))
        if ego is None:
            raise RuntimeError('Original U-turn subject spawn failed')
        owned.append(ego)
        for name, width, height in CAMERAS:
            point, angles, attach = CAMERA_POSES[name]
            camera_bp = blueprints.find('sensor.camera.rgb')
            for key, value in (('image_size_x', width), ('image_size_y', height),
                               ('fov', 85), ('sensor_tick', .05)):
                camera_bp.set_attribute(key, str(value))
            pose = carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=point[0], y=point[1], z=point[2]),
                                   carla.Rotation(roll=angles[0], pitch=angles[1], yaw=angles[2]))
            sensor = (world.spawn_actor(camera_bp, pose, attach_to=ego)
                      if attach else world.spawn_actor(camera_bp, pose))
            owned.append(sensor)
            image_queue = queue.Queue()
            sensor.listen(image_queue.put)
            cameras[name] = image_queue
            encoders[name] = subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg', '-nostdin', '-hide_banner',
                '-loglevel', 'error', '-n', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'bgra',
                '-s', f'{width}x{height}', '-r', '20', '-i', '-', '-frames:v', '600',
                '-c:v', 'ffv1', str(output/(name+'.mkv'))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        capture = PipelineCapture(client, ego, output, config['selected_case_id'],
                                  required_observations=())
        targets = request['route_waypoints_xy_m'][1:]
        target_index = 0
        with (output/'native-uturn.jsonl').open('x') as motion, \
                (output/'body_history.jsonl').open('x') as body_history, \
                FrameMap(output/'video_frames.jsonl') as frame_map:
            for index in range(FRAMES):
                distance, steer = control_to_target(ego, targets[target_index])
                if distance < 2.0 and target_index < len(targets)-1:
                    target_index += 1
                    distance, steer = control_to_target(ego, targets[target_index])
                done = target_index == len(targets)-1 and distance < 2.0
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0 if done else .28,
                    brake=1 if done else 0, steer=0 if done else steer))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                capture.capture(native_frame, index/20)
                ego_source = ego_row(ego)
                motion.write(json.dumps({'native_frame': native_frame,
                    'video_frame': index, 'time_s': index/20,
                    'source_kind': 'original_native', 'ego': ego_source,
                    'route_target_index': target_index, 'legal_verdict': None},
                    allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                body_history.write(json.dumps({'frame': index, 'time_s': index/20,
                    'body_vertices_m': ego_source['body_xyz_m'],
                    'heading_deg': ego_source['yaw_deg']}, allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                mapped = {}
                for name, image_queue in cameras.items():
                    image = image_queue.get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame < native_frame:
                        image = image_queue.get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame != native_frame:
                        raise RuntimeError('Camera/native frame join differs: '+name)
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    mapped[name] = image.frame
                frame_map.append(native_frame, index/20, camera_native_frames=mapped)
        capture.close()
        capture = None
        for name, encoder in encoders.items():
            encoder.stdin.close()
            stderr = encoder.stderr.read()
            if encoder.wait(timeout=180):
                raise RuntimeError('Camera encode failed: '+name+stderr.decode()[-200:])
        (output/'divided-road-context.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'source_kind': 'original_native_divided_road_readback',
            'authored_road_ids': list(ROAD_IDS),
            'native_map_sha256': hashlib.sha256(map_source.encode()).hexdigest(),
            'native_roadways': roadways, 'median_objects': objects,
            'median_bounds_m': request['median_bounds_m'],
            'opening_bounds_m': request['opening_bounds_m'],
            'barrier_bounds_m': request['barrier_bounds_m'],
            'public_authority_establishment': 'pending_original_source',
            'original_body_and_pixels_reviewed': False,
            'legal_verdict': None}, indent=2)+'\n')
    finally:
        if capture is not None:
            capture.close(confirmed=False)
        for encoder in encoders.values():
            if encoder.poll() is None:
                encoder.kill()
                encoder.wait()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if hasattr(actor, 'stop'):
                    actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if changed:
            restoration = restore(client, saved)
    (output/'acquisition-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({
        'provenance_kind': 'native', 'diagnostic_fixture': False,
        'physical_acceptance_claimed': False})+'\n')
    seal_capture(output, frames=FRAMES, restoration=restoration, errors=[],
                 encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in cameras},
                 context={'authored_road_ids': list(ROAD_IDS)})
    return {'frames': FRAMES, 'source_review_complete': False,
            'physical_acceptance_claimed': False}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--host', default='localhost')
    parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check()))
    else:
        if args.output_dir is None:
            parser.error('Native output directory required')
        print(json.dumps(execute(args.output_dir, args.host, args.port)))

"""Finalize a saved divided-road U-turn without assigning a legal outcome."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from measure_uturn import measure_attempt as _measure_attempt


def measure_attempt(attempt):
    """Selected contract entrypoint for the saved U-turn meter."""
    return _measure_attempt(attempt)

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
SOURCES = ("request.json", "divided-road-context.json", "authority-review.json",
           "native-uturn.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl")


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def finalize(attempt, output):
    attempt, output = Path(attempt).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() or (attempt / "result.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Use a fresh saved analysis version")
    for name in ("config.json", "construction.json", "trace.jsonl",
                 "body_history.jsonl", "capture/evidence.jsonl", *SOURCES,
                 *(name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS)):
        if not (attempt / name).is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    construction = json.loads((attempt / "construction.json").read_text())
    request = json.loads((attempt / "request.json").read_text())
    case = request["case_id"]
    if config.get("selected_case_id") != case or construction.get("case_id") != case:
        raise ValueError("Exact saved case identity differs")
    measurement = measure_attempt(attempt)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / "native-uturn.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    context = json.loads((attempt / "divided-road-context.json").read_text())
    channels = attempt / "channels"
    channels.mkdir()
    values = {
        "ego_pose": lambda row: row["ego"],
        "median_crossing_location": lambda row: {
            "body_xy_m": row["ego"]["body_xy_m"],
            "roadways": context["native_roadways"],
            "median_bounds_m": context["median_bounds_m"],
            "opening_bounds_m": context["opening_bounds_m"],
            "source_frame": row["video_frame"],
        },
    }
    evidence = []
    for name, value in values.items():
        path = channels / (name + ".jsonl")
        with path.open("x") as stream:
            for row in rows:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": value(row)},
                                        allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": "structured", "reference": "channels/" + path.name})
    through_opening = measurement["opening_overlap_frames"] > 0
    outside_opening = measurement["median_without_opening_overlap_frames"] > 0
    target = request["case_id"].split("__")[-1]
    geometry_seen = through_opening if target == "authorized_opening" else outside_opening
    diagnostic = measurement["source_kind"] != "original_native"
    result = {
        "case_id": case, "measured_values": measurement,
        "target_checks": [{"target": "original divided-road body crossing",
                           "requested": target, "measured": measurement,
                           "method": "measure_attempt", "tolerance": {},
                           "matched": geometry_seen,
                           "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                           "cause_evidence": list(SOURCES)}],
        "setup_confirmed": False,
        "behavior_attempted": not diagnostic,
        "maneuver_completed": False,
        "termination_reason": "600-frame geometry analyzed; original authority and physical review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": ["Public-authority establishment, physical crossing and pixels require original review"],
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": construction["recording_description"],
        "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {},
        "provenance_kind": "synthetic_local_diagnostic" if diagnostic else "native",
        "accepted": False,
    }
    for parent in (attempt, *attempt.parents):
        if (parent / "runtime" / "scenario_pipeline").is_dir():
            sys.path.insert(0, str(parent / "runtime"))
            break
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
    write_result(attempt, result)
    # request.json is frozen inside the selected construction; the diagnostic
    # fixture inventories only separately acquired source files.
    sources = {name: sha(attempt / name) for name in SOURCES if name != "request.json"}
    report = {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case,
              "measurements": {name: {"method": "measure_attempt", "value": measurement,
                                       "sources": sources}
                               for name in ("right_hand_roadway", "divider_crossing",
                                            "u_turn_event", "opening_geometry", "authority_context")},
              "source_complete": True, "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic,
              "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    finalize(args.attempt, args.output)

"""Independent source audit for saved divided-road U-turn measurements.

Diagnostic mode tests the source joins. Original mode additionally requires a
sealed Native acquisition; neither mode decides authority or legal compliance.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from measure_uturn import measure_attempt

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
SOURCES = ("request.json", "divided-road-context.json", "authority-review.json",
           "native-uturn.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    if not Path(path).is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing original delivery source: " + Path(path).name)
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def audit(attempt, report_path, diagnostic=False):
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    report = read(report_path)
    result = read(attempt / "result.json")
    config = read(attempt / "config.json")
    construction = read(attempt / "construction.json")
    request = read(attempt / "request.json")
    case = request.get("case_id")
    if not case or any(item.get("case_id") != case for item in (report, result, construction)) or config.get("selected_case_id") != case:
        raise ValueError("Saved exact U-turn case identity differs")
    measurement = measure_attempt(attempt)
    if report.get("format") != "worker-analysis-report" or report.get("source_complete") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Saved analysis report incomplete")
    if report.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not diagnostic:
        raise ValueError("Saved provenance differs from audit mode")
    sources = {name: digest(attempt / name) for name in SOURCES
               if name != "request.json"}
    for name in ("right_hand_roadway", "divider_crossing", "u_turn_event",
                 "opening_geometry", "authority_context"):
        entry = report.get("measurements", {}).get(name, {})
        if entry.get("sources") != sources or entry.get("value") != measurement:
            raise ValueError("Saved measurement or source hash differs: " + name)
    if result.get("measured_values") != measurement or result.get("accepted") is not False:
        raise ValueError("Saved result or acceptance claim differs")
    if (measurement.get("authority_verified") is not False or
            measurement.get("legal_judgment") != "unresolved"):
        raise ValueError("Authority or legal conclusion was inferred")
    if result.get("video_references") != [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS] or result.get("video_frame_map_reference") != "video_frames.jsonl":
        raise ValueError("Four original camera references missing")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        if not (attempt / (name + ".mkv")).is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing original camera source: " + name)
    for name in ("ego_pose", "median_crossing_location"):
        channel = attempt / "channels" / (name + ".jsonl")
        if not channel.is_file() or len(channel.read_text().splitlines()) != 600:
            raise ValueError("Saved 600-frame channel incomplete: " + name)
    if not diagnostic:
        provenance = read(attempt / "acquisition-provenance.json")
        seal = read(attempt / "capture-seal.json")
        context = read(attempt / "divided-road-context.json")
        authority = read(attempt / "authority-review.json")
        if (provenance.get("provenance_kind") != "native" or
                provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not False or
                context.get("source_kind") != "original_native_divided_road_readback" or
                len(context.get("native_roadways", [])) != 2 or
                len(context.get("median_objects", [])) != 2 or
                seal.get("format") != "worker-sealed-capture" or
                seal.get("provenance_kind") != "native" or
                seal.get("frames") != 600 or
                seal.get("restoration", {}).get("restored") is not True or
                seal.get("encoder_exit_codes") != {name: 0 for name in CAMERAS}):
            raise ValueError("Sealed original Native road and median source missing")
        sealed_sources = seal.get("sources", {})
        for name in (*(source for source in SOURCES if source != "authority-review.json"),
                     "trace.jsonl", "body_history.jsonl",
                     "capture/evidence.jsonl", *(camera + ".mkv" for camera in CAMERAS)):
            if sealed_sources.get(name) != digest(attempt / name):
                raise ValueError("Sealed original source hash differs: " + name)
        if (authority.get("review_status") != "independently_reviewed" or
                not authority.get("independent_reviewer") or
                authority.get("public_authority_establishment") not in
                    ("verified_opening", "not_established", "undetermined")):
            raise ValueError("Independent public-authority establishment review missing")
    return {"format": "c82860-independent-delivery-source-audit-v1",
            "case_id": case, "source_hashes": sources,
            "camera_source_hashes": {name: digest(attempt / (name + ".mkv")) for name in CAMERAS},
            "original_native_gate_checked": not diagnostic,
            "source_joins_passed": True, "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnostic", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(audit(args.attempt, args.report, args.diagnostic), indent=2))

"""Audit the fixed context of two saved divided-road U-turn measurements."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from measure_uturn import measure_attempt
from road_request import CAMERAS, request


def audit(opening_attempt, barrier_attempt):
    attempts = (Path(opening_attempt), Path(barrier_attempt))
    suffixes = ("authorized_opening", "barrier_crossing")
    contexts = []
    measurements = []
    fixed_configs = []
    for path, suffix in zip(attempts, suffixes):
        actual_request = json.loads((path / "request.json").read_text())
        if actual_request != request(suffix):
            raise ValueError("Exact comparison request or controlled location differs")
        config = json.loads((path / "config.json").read_text())
        if config.get("selected_case_id") != actual_request["case_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Exact comparison selected case differs")
        fixed_configs.append({key: config.get(key) for key in
                              ("cell_id", "law_id", "actor", "rate_hz", "duration_s",
                               "frames", "cameras", "physical_completion")})
        context = json.loads((path / "divided-road-context.json").read_text())
        review = json.loads((path / "authority-review.json").read_text())
        contexts.append((context, review))
        measurements.append(measure_attempt(path))
    left, right = contexts
    if fixed_configs[0] != fixed_configs[1]:
        raise ValueError("Fixed camera, duration or physical criterion differs")
    for key in ("authored_road_ids", "median_bounds_m", "opening_bounds_m",
                "barrier_bounds_m", "source_kind", "native_roadways"):
        if left[0].get(key) != right[0].get(key):
            raise ValueError("Fixed original road or median context differs: " + key)
    if left[1]["source"]["sha256"] != right[1]["source"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Fixed authority source differs")
    opening, barrier = measurements
    if opening["opening_overlap_frames"] == 0 or opening["median_without_opening_overlap_frames"]:
        raise ValueError("Opening crossing did not realize the diagnostic contrast")
    if barrier["median_without_opening_overlap_frames"] == 0 or barrier["opening_overlap_frames"]:
        raise ValueError("Barrier crossing did not realize the diagnostic contrast")
    return {"format": "c82860-comparison-audit-v1",
            "cases": [request(suffix)["case_id"] for suffix in suffixes],
            "controlled_difference": "median_crossing_location",
            "fixed_context_checked": True,
            "camera_count": len(CAMERAS),
            "diagnostic_geometry_contrast": True,
            "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False}
